1. Once the event begins, Polaris Institute will reveal this period’s mystery Aniimo silhouette.
2. The initial silhouette will only show the mystery Aniimo’s distinctive features, with the remaining parts hidden. Pathfinders can reveal the hidden parts by photographing Aniimo that share the same features as the mystery Aniimo.
3. Photograph an Aniimo matching the silhouette’s corresponding form and submit it to complete the research topic and claim the corresponding rewards. Successfully photographing before the full silhouette is revealed earns you bonus Aniimo Observation Rewards!
4. Pathfinders can also select photos from their existing album that meet the topic requirements for submission. If a photo contains this period’s mystery Aniimo, it counts toward event completion too.
5. Pay attention to Aniimo forms — only photos where the submitted Aniimo matches the mystery Aniimo’s exact form will count toward event completion.
6. Pathfinders can complete the event by photographing their own Aniimo, other players’ Aniimo, or wild Aniimo on the continent of Idyll.
7. Aniimo in the Holo-Battle Sim are holographic projections, and Aniimo found in Sanctums are bound by ancient seals. Photos taken in these two locations cannot be recognized or submitted.
